title: Order of the remaining work
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The earlier order is done or overtaken: the line between meaning and mechanics, and delivering the workflow's design to every project, are realized.
decision: Recommended: (1) realize intent-based delegation; (2) the consumer trial, kino on a film-production project, which waits for the operator; (3) contracts between contexts, as a story; (4) the ipseic round. Priority is the operator's.
consequences: Accepted, it replaces the earlier order.
